examples.name: A small homelab stack
examples.before:
services:
  web:
    image: nginx:1.26
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
    environment:
      TZ: America/Vancouver
      LOG_LEVEL: info
    volumes:
      - ./site:/usr/share/nginx/html:ro
    restart: unless-stopped
  cache:
    image: redis:7
examples.after:
services:
  web:
    image: nginx:1.28
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:8080:80"
    environment:
      - TZ=America/Vancouver
      - LOG_LEVEL=warn
    volumes:
      - ./site:/usr/share/nginx/html:ro
    restart: unless-stopped
    read_only: true
  worker:
    image: alpine:3.22
    command: ["echo", "Ready"]

examples.name: Equivalent environment forms
examples.before:
services:
  app:
    image: alpine:3.22
    environment:
      TZ: America/Halifax
      PORT: "8080"
examples.after:
services:
  app:
    environment: [PORT=8080, TZ=America/Halifax]
    image: alpine:3.22

commandExample: docker run -d --name local-web -p 127.0.0.1:8080:80 -v ./site:/usr/share/nginx/html:ro -e TZ=America/Vancouver --restart unless-stopped nginx:1.28
